desc: Yoaz Hendel's party, founded in 2025 out of a post-October 7 movement for reserve soldiers and their families. Ran as Zionist Home with Chili Tropper until the two split in September 2026 — Tropper joined Yashar, Hendel kept the party and merged with Yaron Zelekha's New Economic Party, adding an economic platform to a security one. His refusal to sit with the ultra-Orthodox over the draft makes a Netanyahu-led coalition hard to join, which leaves the change bloc as his likelier home.

name: The Haredi Public

note: Below the threshold — bloc placement unconfirmed
_why: Polls inside the 'Others' column, so fetch_polls.py cannot see it; seats and percentage are set by hand here. Left unaligned deliberately: it is a revolt against the Haredi leadership rather than an extension of it, and it has not said whose government it would join.
desc: Launched ahead of the 2026 election by Beit Shemesh deputy mayor Moti Leitner, out of what it calls a disconnect between the Haredi public and its political leadership. It speaks for working and immigrant Haredim underrepresented by Shas and UTJ, and put Dr Nechumi Yaffe on its slate — the first woman ever to run for the Knesset on an ultra-Orthodox list. It has not cleared the threshold in any poll.

positions.draft: Speaks for working Haredim, which cuts against the blanket exemption Shas and UTJ defend — but it has not set out a position.
